title: satk.util.channelstripMn~
description: `satk.util.channelstripMn~` emulates a slim in-line mixer channel strip for a mono input, providing VU metering, gain control, and stereo panning to left and right outputs. Gain can be set linearly from 0 to 1 or in dBFS from -20 to +6, while pan ranges from 0 (left) through 0.5 (center) to 1 (right); it requires the ELSE and CYCLONE libraries.
